objective: Determine the coarsest uniform count algebra sufficient on the six remaining nonnegative pair buckets C+,C-,D+,D-,A+,A- of the common owner-symmetric signed-parity exchange carrier.

countModes.name: BUCKET_PRESENCE
countModes.definition: For every bucket n retain only [n>0].

countModes.name: BUCKET_PARITY
countModes.definition: For every bucket n retain n mod 2.

countModes.name: BUCKET_ZOE
countModes.definition: For every bucket retain Z if n=0, O if n>0 is odd, E if n>0 is even.

countModes.name: BUCKET_CLIP2
countModes.definition: For every bucket retain min(n,2), interpreted as 0,1,2+.

countModes.name: BUCKET_CLIP3
countModes.definition: For every bucket retain min(n,3), interpreted as 0,1,2,3+.

countModes.name: BUCKET_EXACT
countModes.definition: Retain all six exact nonnegative bucket counts; reconstruction control.

structuralProcedure: Start from each frozen EW-RS-074 D_SYMMETRIC_MARGINALS pair signature.
Apply one declared count transform independently and uniformly to all six buckets.
Form each OOO triple key as the sorted multiset of its three transformed pair signatures.
Freeze candidate feature catalogs, matched-dependency rows, and structural bases before scalar replay.

valuation.noForcedTotalOrder: PRESENCE and PARITY are incomparable projections; ZOE, clipped counts, and exact counts are compared by measured structural image and scalar sufficiency rather than assumed ordering.
valuation.preferredEvidence: Report every common-exact mode, structural image rank, and failures; do not outcome-select bucket-specific exceptions.

antiCircularity: The six buckets, six count modes, and uniform-transform rule are frozen before scalar inspection.
No bucket-specific transform, threshold, or exception is selected using W/D/L.
The EW-RS-074 owner quotient and EW-RS-065 matched dependencies are unchanged.
EW-RS-059 PRIMARY 3x6-k4 and BACKUP 5x3-k4 remain sealed.
falsifiers: BUCKET_EXACT must reproduce EW-RS-074 D_SYMMETRIC_MARGINALS ranks 73,254,14 with zero contradictions.
Any candidate with zero structural residue and nonzero scalar residue is insufficient.
No post-hoc bucket-specific rescue is allowed.
nextIfCoarseCountPasses: Freeze the coarsest/common exact count algebra and test whether C/D/A bucket families or plus/minus channels can be merged into a smaller circuit representation.
nextIfExactRequired: Retain exact six counts and move to outcome-independent circuit/basis reduction over the six-bucket triangle.
interpretationGuards: This count quotient concerns late-stage exchange buckets, not the upstream ZOE multiplicity coordinate.
A passing ZOE-like count law here does not imply the same algebra is universal for other count layers.
No Q-A/Q-F, standard-7x6, universal theorem, or center-opening proof follows.
